packageRules.description: Lanes: a line stays within its major version, where semver promises compatibility. Updates to a newer major wait on the Dependency Dashboard; start the new lane by adding a line. Such updates get renovate/new-lane-* branches, apart from the updates inside a lane.
Lanes for 0.x: semver promises compatibility only within a minor version, so each minor version is a lane.

Minor lanes: these upstreams start a new release line at every minor version (alpine/k8s follows Kubernetes, and kubectl supports one minor version of skew; MongoDB's releases are X.0, and 8.1 to 8.3 are rapid releases).

gitea/runner-images tags are ubuntu-<release>-v<yy.mm.dd>. Keep each Ubuntu release and move to its newest dated build; a date is not a compatibility boundary, so a new year needs no approval and no branch of its own.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, check that the new image still ships Node.js 24: the Gitea runner on linyi-k8s sets `runner.node_download: false` and runs JS actions with the image's Node.js.
